close_reason: Performance optimization: single-pass extension scan deferred to v0.2. Not a correctness issue.
description: For each certificate, chain_walk calls: check_critical_extensions (scans all extensions), cert_basic_constraints (scans all extensions), has_key_cert_sign (scans all extensions). That is up to 3 linear scans over the extension list per cert. For a typical cert with 5-8 extensions this is negligible (15-24 comparisons). For pathological certs with many extensions (e.g., enterprise CAs sometimes have 20+ extensions), this becomes 3*E comparisons per cert. A single pass that extracts BasicConstraints, KeyUsage, and validates critical extensions simultaneously would be cleaner and constant-factor faster. Not a hot-path concern for typical chains, but the three-scan pattern is also an elegance issue.
title: extensions list scanned separately for BasicConstraints, KeyUsage, critical check
